perimeter_blueprint_track_gates.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_blueprint_track_gates.py  # every track in BLUEPRINT names an eval gate id that exists in the registry

perimeter_ci_workflow_contract.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_ci_workflow.py  # report/upload steps use if: ${{ !cancelled() }}; no secrets.*, no curl/wget, LLM provider=fake

perimeter_docs_diagrams_render.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_mermaid_types.py  # only flowchart/sequence/stateDiagram; no 'journey' blocks

perimeter_ledger_cap_enforced.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_ledger_cap.py  # cases: under cap pass, at cap block, over block, missing ledger block, unparseable block

perimeter_no_local_paths.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_no_local_paths.py  # no /Users/, /home/, C:\\ paths in tracked files

perimeter_no_secrets_committed.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_no_secrets.py  # .env not tracked (git ls-files), .env in .gitignore, .env.example exists with placeholders only, no key patterns in tracked files

perimeter_roi_inputs_parametrised.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_roi_inputs.py  # fails if 8.5/16/85 literals appear outside src/config/roiDefaults.ts

perimeter_roi_monotonic_increasing.script: npx vitest run tests/roi_property.test.ts --reporter=json  # seeded property test: >=200 random (counts, rates) pairs; ROI non-decreasing in each count AND each rate; strictly increasing when rate>0; rejects negative/NaN rates

perimeter_test_harness_present.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_test_harness.py  # package.json has test script + pinned vitest; scripts/gates exists

perimeter_track_count_consistent.script: python3 scripts/gates/check_track_count.py --expected 11  # spec, README frontmatter and blueprint all list exactly 11 tracks
